arguments.title: Formspec Cloud
arguments.brief: Managed hosted-forms and signature SaaS. Customer and administrator work stays in the app; public respondents use a short mobile-first flow. Every exposed capability is live, assisted, preview, or disabled.

binding.content: LIVE — Workspace summary, published forms, responses, signatures, and plan usage. Connected navigation includes Forms, Responses, Integrations, Administration, Billing, Support, and public completion.
LIVE — Create organization, workspace, production and sandbox environments, and invite teammates. SSO/SAML/SCIM is ASSISTED with visible request status.
LIVE — Curated templates or Studio import; publish, share, version pin, basic branding. Collaborative authoring is PREVIEW.
LIVE — Draft/published version, hosted link, share controls, response count, notifications, and PDF status for tenant formId.
PREVIEW — Check mobile layout, validation, review, and confirmation before publishing.
LIVE — View tenant responses, export CSV/JSON, receipts, certificates, and proof status. Bulk export packages are ASSISTED.
LIVE — Basic envelopes, status, reminders, completion, and certificates. Enhanced identity proofing, witness/notary, and bulk send are DISABLED.
LIVE — API keys, generated API docs, sandbox/test, one webhook, delivery history. Connectors are PREVIEW; large imports are ASSISTED.
LIVE — Organization, workspaces, roles, invitations, branding, feature visibility. Domains and retention/legal hold are ASSISTED; DSAR self-service is DISABLED.
LIVE — Plan limits, usage, billing status, and entitlements; availability reflects entitlement, feature state, deployment profile, and adapter health.
LIVE — Status, support, incident records, trust center, and subprocessors. Dedicated review is ASSISTED; active-active is DISABLED.
LIVE — Anonymous mobile completion with validation, review, submit, notices, and confirmation. No respondent account or dashboard.
LIVE — Submission receipt and verifier-backed proof status. Hosted general verification is DISABLED; documented CLI/library verification remains available.

binding.content: LIVE — Workspace summary, published forms, responses, signatures, and plan usage. Connected navigation includes Forms, Responses, Integrations, Administration, Billing, Support, and public completion.
LIVE — Create organization, workspace, production and sandbox environments, and invite teammates. SSO/SAML/SCIM is ASSISTED with visible request status.
LIVE — Curated templates or Studio import; publish, share, version pin, basic branding. Collaborative authoring is PREVIEW.
LIVE — Draft/published version, hosted link, share controls, response count, notifications, and PDF status for tenant formId.

params.name: formId
params.description: Tenant-scoped published or draft form identifier.

binding.content: PREVIEW — Check mobile layout, validation, review, and confirmation before publishing.
LIVE — View tenant responses, export CSV/JSON, receipts, certificates, and proof status. Bulk export packages are ASSISTED.
LIVE — Basic envelopes, status, reminders, completion, and certificates. Enhanced identity proofing, witness/notary, and bulk send are DISABLED.
LIVE — API keys, generated API docs, sandbox/test, one webhook, delivery history. Connectors are PREVIEW; large imports are ASSISTED.
LIVE — Organization, workspaces, roles, invitations, branding, feature visibility. Domains and retention/legal hold are ASSISTED; DSAR self-service is DISABLED.
LIVE — Plan limits, usage, billing status, and entitlements; availability reflects entitlement, feature state, deployment profile, and adapter health.
LIVE — Status, support, incident records, trust center, and subprocessors. Dedicated review is ASSISTED; active-active is DISABLED.
LIVE — Anonymous mobile completion with validation, review, submit, notices, and confirmation. No respondent account or dashboard.
LIVE — Submission receipt and verifier-backed proof status. Hosted general verification is DISABLED; documented CLI/library verification remains available.
